name: Grandaddy Purp All-in-One THC Pen | 1g
description:
Extracted from a variety of natural flora, STIIIZY’s naturally derived terpenes offer a balanced aroma to deliver a quality experience every time. Our premium concentrates uphold a high level of purity, setting the industry standard to influence and inspire through innovative methods.

Granddaddy Purp is an indica-dominant hybrid with a berry-forward profile and earthy undertones.
